item.title: Concerns raised over Co Cavan pedestrian crossing
item.description: A local councillor has voiced concerns about a pedestrian crossing in Co Cavan. It is reported that a pedestrian crossing on Churchstreet in Cootehill has caused people to hurt themselves. Stiofan Conaty says it is an issue that comes up when knocking on doors in the area, particularly in the estates there. Advertisement He said it leads to people crossing the road at more dangerous points Speaking to Northern Sound Cllr Conaty outlined why it's important to be done up properly.

item.description: 38 roads are currently flooded which are predominantly in South Monaghan. item.title: Man to appear in court tomorrow over Crossmaglen cannabis seizure
item.description: Police have charged a man to court following the discovery of a cannabis farm in the Lismore area of Crossmaglen on Friday. The man, aged 28, has been charged with cultivating cannabis, being concerned in the supply of a class B controlled drug, possession of a class B controlled drug with intent to supply and possession of a class B controlled drug.
